name: Fasahar Kuɗi da AI (Fintech)
objectives: Idan aka ba ku manhajojin kuɗin da ke wayarku, gane nau'o'in fintech guda huɗu da hanya ɗaya da kowanne ke amfani da AI, kuma ku faɗi abin da za ku iya yi idan shawarar AI game da kuɗinku ba daidai ba ce
Don manhajar kuɗi ɗaya da kuke amfani da ita, duba ko kuɗin da ke cikin manhajar suna da kariyar inshorar ajiya ta FDIC, ta hanyar nemo bankin abokin hulɗarta da tabbatar da shi a FDIC BankFind
Idan kun ji labarin robo-advisor ko crypto, bayanin yadda kowanne ke aiki da jera manyan haɗarinsa, kuna kwatanta jerin haɗarin da majiyar hukuma kamar FTC
Kafin ku saka kuɗi a manhaja, yin binciken abubuwa biyar a kan manhajar, kuna rubuta i ko a'a ga kowane abu
A manhajar kuɗi ɗaya, kunna tabbatarwa mai matakai biyu da sanarwar biya, da cire na'urorin da ba ku sani ba, ba tare da bayyana kowace kalmar sirri ko code ba
Idan aka ba ku saƙo, kira ko tayi game da kuɗi, gane alamun gargaɗin zambar fintech da kai rahotonta inda ya dace, ba tare da bayar da kowane code ko biyan komai ba

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Yadda fintech ke aiki

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Mene ne fintech, kuma ina AI yake shiga
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 4
Manufa: Ambaci nau'o'in fintech guda huɗu da hanya ɗaya da kowanne ke amfani da AI.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku manhajojin kuɗin da ke wayarku, za ku iya gane nau'o'in fintech guda huɗu da hanya ɗaya da kowanne ke amfani da AI, kuma ku faɗi abin da za ku iya yi idan shawarar AI game da kuɗinku ba daidai ba ce.
Fintech na nufin fasahar kuɗi: manhajoji da shafukan intanet na kuɗi. Nau'o'in da aka saba gani su ne bankin waya, manhajojin biya don tura kuɗi ga mutane, manhajojin kasafin kuɗi, masu ba da rance ta intanet da manhajojin zuba jari.
Ana amfani da AI a ɓoye: don gane zamba (kati da aka yi amfani da shi a ƙasashe biyu cikin awa ɗaya), don amsa tambayoyi a chatbot, don raba kashe kuɗinku zuwa rukuni-rukuni, da don taimakawa wajen yanke wa ake ba rance.
Shawarwarin AI suna iya zama ba daidai ba. Ana iya hana sayayya ta gaske, ko a ƙi ba da rance saboda bayanai marasa kyau. Kuna da haƙƙin tambayar dalili da ƙalubalantar kuskure; Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB, hukumar kare masu amfani da hidimomin kuɗi ta Amurka) tana bayanin waɗannan haƙƙoƙi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Fintech: fasahar kuɗi: manhajoji da shafukan intanet na ajiya a banki, biya, rance, kasafin kuɗi da zuba jari.
- Gane zamba (fraud detection): kayan aiki da ke sa ido kan biyan kuɗi da ke kama da na sata ko na bogi.
- Chatbot: shirin AI da ke amsa tambayoyi ta hira.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- CFPB: Rayuwar kuɗi ta soja (sojoji masu aiki da tsofaffin sojoji)
Gwada yanzu: Ku jera kowace manhajar kuɗi da ke wayarku. A gefen kowacce, ku rubuta wane nau'in fintech ce da hanya ɗaya da za ta iya amfani da AI.
Yanzu za ku iya bayanin manyan nau'o'in fintech da yadda suke amfani da AI.

options: Littafin cak na takarda
Tulun ajiyar kuɗi a gida
Manhajar biya a wayarku
Bayanin asusun banki da aka buga a takarda
check.why: Fintech na nufin manhajoji da shafukan intanet na kuɗi, kamar manhajojin biya, banki, kasafin kuɗi da zuba jari.

check.q: AI na manhajar kuɗinku ya ɗauki biyan kuɗin hayarku na yau da kullum a matsayin zamba ya hana shi. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku tuntuɓi kamfanin, ku tambayi dalili ku ƙalubalanci kuskuren
Ku goge manhajar kada ku sake biyan haya ta intanet
Ku ba su kalmar sirrinku don su gyara
Ku jira ku yi fatan zai wuce
check.why: Idan shawarar AI game da kuɗinku ba daidai ba ce, kuna iya tambayar dalili ku ƙalubalance ta.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Inda kuɗinku suke da gaske: bankuna, manhajoji da inshora
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Duba ko kuɗin da ke cikin manhaja suna da kariyar inshorar ajiya ta FDIC.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don manhajar kuɗi ɗaya da kuke amfani da ita, za ku iya duba ko kuɗin da ke cikin manhajar suna da kariyar inshorar ajiya ta FDIC, ta hanyar nemo bankin abokin hulɗarta da tabbatar da shi a FDIC BankFind.
Inshorar ajiya ta FDIC tana kare kuɗi a asusun ajiya (checking, savings, money market deposit account da CD) a bankin da ke da inshorar FDIC. Lokacin da muka duba fdic.gov a watan Oktoba 2026, adadin da aka saba shi ne aƙalla $250,000 ga kowane mai ajiya a kowane banki mai inshora.
Inshorar FDIC ba ta rufe hannayen jari (stocks), bonds, mutual funds, annuities, inshorar rai ko kadarorin crypto. Manhajojin biya da yawa ba bankuna ba ne. Kuɗin da aka bar a cikin manhaja bazai da inshora ba sai idan manhajar ta saka shi a asusun banki mai inshora a madadinku.
Don dubawa: ku karanta shafin taimako na manhajar don sunan bankin abokin hulɗarta, sannan ku nemi bankin da kayan aikin BankFind na FDIC a fdic.gov.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe shafin taimako ko na doka na manhajar ku nemi "FDIC" da sunan banki.
- Ku nemi sunan bankin da FDIC BankFind a fdic.gov.
- Ku duba ko irin kuɗinku (ajiya, hannun jari, crypto) yana da inshora.
- Idan ba ku tabbata ba, ku mayar da kuɗin kashewa zuwa asusun banki mai inshora.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- FDIC: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation: tana kare ajiya a bankuna masu inshora idan bankin ya rushe.
- Asusun ajiya (deposit account): asusun checking, savings, money market deposit account ko CD a banki.
- BankFind: kayan aikin FDIC kyauta don duba ko banki yana da inshorar FDIC.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- FDIC: Inshorar ajiya
Gwada yanzu: Ku zaɓi manhajar kuɗi ɗaya da kuke amfani da ita. Ku nemo bankin abokin hulɗarta a shafukan taimako na manhajar, ku duba bankin a FDIC BankFind. Ku rubuta ko kuɗinku suna da inshora.
Yanzu za ku iya duba ko kuɗin da ke cikin manhaja suna da kariyar inshorar ajiya ta FDIC.

options: Manhajar rance
Kasuwar crypto
Kayan aikin maki na bashi (credit score)
Kayan aikin FDIC don duba ko banki yana da inshora
check.why: BankFind yana bar ku tabbatar da cewa banki yana da inshorar FDIC.

check.q: Wata manhajar biya ta ce kuɗinku "suna lafiya". Yaya za ku duba ko suna da inshora?
options: Ku amince da tallar manhajar
Ku nemo bankin abokin hulɗarta a shafukan taimako ku neme shi a BankFind
Ku tambayi mataimakin AI
Ku ɗauka cewa dukkan manhajoji bankuna ne
check.why: Inshora ya dogara ne kan ko manhajar tana ajiye kuɗinku a banki mai inshora, wanda kuke tabbatarwa a BankFind.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Yadda robo-advisor da crypto ke aiki, da haɗarinsu
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Bayyana yadda robo-advisor da crypto ke aiki da faɗin manyan haɗarinsu.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan kun ji labarin robo-advisor ko crypto, za ku iya bayanin yadda kowanne ke aiki da jera manyan haɗarinsa, kuna kwatanta jerin haɗarin da majiyar hukuma kamar FTC.
Robo-advisor manhaja ce da ke amfani da dokokin kwamfuta don saka kuɗinku a jari bisa amsoshin da kuka bayar, kamar burinku da tsawon lokacin kafin ku buƙaci kuɗin. Tana karɓar kuɗin hidima. Jari yana iya rasa daraja, kuma ba shi da inshorar FDIC.
Crypto (cryptocurrency) kuɗin intanet ne da ake rubutawa a wani babban littafin bayanai na intanet da ake rabawa, mai suna blockchain. Farashinsa yana iya hawa ya sauka sosai. FTC (hukumar kasuwanci ta Amurka) ta yi gargaɗin cewa biyan kuɗi da crypto yawanci ba ya juyuwa, kuma gwamnati ba ta ba crypto inshora kamar yadda take yi wa ajiyar banki.
Wannan kwas ba ya faɗa muku ko ku yi amfani da ɗayansu. Kafin kowace shawarar zuba jari, ku koyi kuɗaɗen hidima da haɗari a shafukan hukuma, ku yi magana da ƙwararre mai zaman kansa da ya cancanta, ko mai ba da shawarar kuɗi kyauta na soja ko na VA.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Robo-advisor: manhajar da ke zuba kuɗi a jari da dokokin kwamfuta bisa amsoshinku.
- Cryptocurrency: kuɗin intanet da ake rubutawa a blockchain.
- Blockchain: rubutaccen bayanin ciniki na intanet da ake rabawa, mai wuyar canjawa sosai.
- Mai sauyi sosai (volatile): farashin da ke iya hawa da sauka sosai, da sauri.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- FTC: Abin da ya kamata ku sani game da cryptocurrency da zamba
- FDIC: Inshorar ajiya
Gwada yanzu: Ku tambayi mataimakin AI: "Ka bayyana yadda robo-advisor ke aiki da yadda crypto ke aiki, da kalmomi masu sauƙi, tare da manyan haɗarin kowanne." Ku kwatanta jerin haɗarinsa da shafin crypto na FTC, ku rubuta duk abin da ya rasa.
Yanzu za ku iya bayanin yadda robo-advisor da crypto ke aiki da faɗin manyan haɗarinsu.

options: Yana zuba jari da dokokin kwamfuta bisa amsoshinku
Wani mutum a banki yana zaɓar hannayen jari kyauta
Yana tabbatar da cewa kuɗinku za su ƙaru
Daidai yake da asusun savings
check.why: Robo-advisor yana amfani da dokokin kwamfuta da amsoshinku don zuba jari; yana da haɗarin kasuwa.

check.q: Wani aboki ya ce crypto "yana da inshora kamar asusun banki". Me za ku faɗa masa?
options: Haka ne
Sai a ƙarshen mako kawai
Crypto ba shi da inshora kamar ajiyar banki, kuma farashinsa yana iya hawa da sauka sosai
Ana iya juyar da biyan crypto koyaushe
check.why: Crypto ba shi da inshora kamar ajiyar banki, farashinsa yana iya canjawa sosai, kuma biya yawanci ba ya juyuwa.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Amfani da fintech lafiya

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Duba manhaja kafin ku amince da ita
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Yi binciken abubuwa biyar a kan manhajar kuɗi kafin ku saka kuɗi a ciki.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Kafin ku saka kuɗi a manhaja, za ku iya yin binciken abubuwa biyar a kan manhajar, kuna rubuta i ko a'a ga kowane abu.
'Yan damfara suna gina manhajoji da shafukan kuɗi na bogi da suke kama da na gaske. Kafin ku sauke manhaja ko ku saka kuɗi, ku duba wane ne ke gudanar da manhajar da ko ta gaske ce.
Ku sauke manhaja daga shagon manhajoji na hukuma kaɗai, ku duba cewa sunan mai ƙirƙira (developer) ya yi daidai da ainihin kamfanin. Ku karanta shafin intanet na kamfanin da kansa don cikakken sunansa da bankin abokin hulɗarsa. Ku duba bankin a FDIC BankFind. Ku nemi sunan kamfanin tare da "complaints" (ƙorafe-ƙorafe), ku kuma duba bayanan ƙorafi na CFPB.
Kuna iya neman mataimakin AI ya bayyana ma'anar sharuɗɗan manhaja, amma kada ku amince da AI ya faɗa muku cewa manhaja tana da lafiya. Ku duba majiyoyin hukuma da kanku.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku sauke daga shagon manhajoji na hukuma kaɗai.
- Ku duba cewa sunan mai ƙirƙira ya yi daidai da ainihin kamfanin.
- Ku nemo cikakken sunan kamfanin da bankin abokin hulɗarsa a shafin intanet nasa.
- Ku duba bankin a FDIC BankFind.
- Ku nemi ƙorafe-ƙorafe, har da a consumerfinance.gov.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Mai ƙirƙira (developer): kamfanin da ya yi manhaja, wanda ake nunawa a shafin manhajar a shagon manhajoji.
- Sharuɗɗan hidima (terms of service): dokoki da kuɗaɗen da kuke yarda da su idan kuna amfani da manhaja.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- CFPB: Rayuwar kuɗi ta soja (ƙorafe-ƙorafe da haƙƙoƙi)
- FDIC: Inshorar ajiya (BankFind)
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi binciken abubuwa biyar a kan manhajar kuɗi ɗaya da kuke amfani da ita ko kuke tunani a kai. Ku rubuta i ko a'a a gefen kowane abu.
Yanzu za ku iya duba ko manhajar kuɗi ta gaske ce kafin ku amince mata da kuɗi.

check.q: Mene ne abu na farko a binciken manhaja na abubuwa biyar?
options: Karanta sharhin mutane a intanet kawai
Sauke daga shagon manhajoji na hukuma kaɗai, daga mai ƙirƙira na gaske
Duba yadda manhajar take da kyau
Tambayar chatbot na manhajar ko tana da lafiya
check.why: Manhajojin bogi suna kwaikwayon na gaske, don haka kuna farawa da samun manhajar gaske daga shagon hukuma.

check.q: Mataimakin AI ya ce sabuwar manhajar kuɗi "tana da lafiya babu shakka". Me za ku yi?
options: Ku saka dukkan ajiyarku a ciki
Ku raba manhajar da abokai
Ku tsallake sauran binciken
Ku yi binciken abubuwa biyar da kanku a majiyoyin hukuma
check.why: AI ba zai iya tabbatar da cewa manhaja tana da lafiya ba; ku ne kuke duba majiyoyin hukuma da kanku.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Kulle asusunku na kuɗi
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Kunna manyan saitin tsaro a manhajar kuɗi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A manhajar kuɗi ɗaya, za ku iya kunna tabbatarwa mai matakai biyu da sanarwar biya, da cire na'urorin da ba ku sani ba, ba tare da bayyana kowace kalmar sirri ko code ba.
Ku ɗauki asusunku na kuɗi kamar wurin da ake tsare: kariya mai matakai da yawa. Ku yi amfani da kalmar sirri mai ƙarfi, ta daban, ga kowane asusun kuɗi, kuma ku kunna tabbatarwa mai matakai biyu (two-step verification) ta yadda sai an sami code ko manhaja kafin a shiga.
Ku kunna sanarwa (alerts) ta yadda manhajar za ta faɗa muku kowane biya, kowane shiga, ko kowane canji ga bayananku. Sanarwa mai sauri tana bar ku dakatar da zamba da wuri.
Kada ku taɓa bayar da code na shiga ga kowa, ko da wanda ya ce daga banki, VA ko manhajar yake. Kamfanoni na gaske ba sa neman sa. Kada ku taɓa rubuta kalmomin sirri ko cikakkun lambobin asusu a mataimakin AI.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku saita kalmar sirri mai ƙarfi, ta daban.
- Ku kunna tabbatarwa mai matakai biyu a saitin tsaro na manhajar.
- Ku kunna sanarwa don biya, shiga da canje-canje.
- Ku duba na'urorin da aka haɗa ku cire duk wadda ba ku sani ba.
- Ku yi wa kanku alƙawari: ba zan taɓa bayar da code na shiga ba.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tabbatarwa mai matakai biyu (two-step verification): bincike na biyu, kamar code ko amincewa a manhaja, da ake buƙata kafin a shiga.
- Sanarwa (alert): saƙon da manhaja ke aikawa idan wani abu ya faru a asusunku.
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe saitin tsaro a manhajar kuɗi ɗaya. Ku kunna tabbatarwa mai matakai biyu da sanarwar biya, ku cire duk na'urar da ba ku gane ba.
Yanzu za ku iya saita manyan saitin tsaro da ke kare asusun kuɗi.

check.q: Me yasa za ku kunna sanarwar biya?
options: Don samun tallace-tallace
Don raba ragowar kuɗinku da abokai
Don gane da dakatar da zamba da wuri
Don manhajar ta fi sauri
check.why: Sanarwa tana faɗa muku kowane biya ta yadda za ku kama zamba da sauri.

check.q: A saitin tsaro na manhajarku kun ga na'urar da ba ku gane ba. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku cire ta ku canja kalmar sirrinku
Ku bar ta; wataƙila babu matsala
Ku kashe tabbatarwa mai matakai biyu
Ku saka hoton allon a intanet
check.why: Na'urar da ba a sani ba tana iya zama wani ne a cikin asusunku, don haka ku cire ta ku kare asusun.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Gane da kai rahoton zambar fintech
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Gane alamun gargaɗin zambar fintech da sanin inda za ku kai rahotonta.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku saƙo, kira ko tayi game da kuɗi, za ku iya gane alamun gargaɗin zambar fintech da kai rahotonta inda ya dace, ba tare da bayar da kowane code ko biyan komai ba.
FTC ta yi gargaɗin cewa 'yan damfara ne kaɗai ke neman a biya su da crypto, 'yan damfara ne kaɗai ke tabbatar da riba ko babbar riba, kuma aikin da ke neman ku biya kuɗin crypto tun farko zamba ne. Abokan soyayya na intanet da ke ba da shawarar zuba jari su ma alamar gargaɗi ne.
'Yan damfara kuma suna yin kamar su banki ne, hukumar gwamnati ko VA, kuma su ce kuɗinku suna cikin haɗari. AI yana bar su rubuta saƙonni marasa kuskure har ma su kwaikwayi murya. Kada ku danna hanyoyin haɗinsu (links) ko ku sake kiran lambobin da suka ba ku; ku yi amfani da lambar da ke shafin intanet na hukuma ko a katinku.
Don kai rahoto: ku shigar da ƙorafi game da wata hidimar kuɗi ga CFPB a consumerfinance.gov ko ta waya, ku kuma kai rahoton zamba ga FTC a ReportFraud.ftc.gov. Ku sanar da bankinku nan take idan kuɗi sun fita daga asusunku.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku lura da: neman biya da crypto, tabbatar da riba, kuɗi tun farko, kiran gaggawa na "kuɗinku suna cikin haɗari".
- Ku tsaya. Kada ku danna, ku biya ko ku bayar da code.
- Ku kira kamfanin ta lambar da ke shafin intanet nasa na hukuma ko a katinku.
- Ku sanar da bankinku nan take idan kuɗi sun motsa.
- Ku kai rahoto ga CFPB ko ReportFraud.ftc.gov.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Zambar yin kamar wani (impostor scam): lokacin da ɗan damfara ya yi kamar shi kamfani ne, hukuma ko mutumin da kuka amince da shi.
- Tabbataccen riba (guaranteed returns): alƙawarin riba ba tare da haɗari ba; jari na gaske ba ya taɓa yin irin wannan alƙawari.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- FTC: Abin da ya kamata ku sani game da cryptocurrency da zamba
- CFPB: Rayuwar kuɗi ta soja (shigar da ƙorafi)
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku yi Katin Tsaron Fintech mai shafi ɗaya don manhaja ɗaya: abin da take yi da yadda take amfani da AI, ko kuɗinku suna da inshora da yadda kuka duba, saitin tsaro da kuka kunna, alamun zamba uku, da inda za ku kai rahoton matsala.
Yanzu za ku iya fahimtar yadda manhajar kuɗi ke aiki, duba ta da kare ta, da gane da kai rahoton zambar fintech.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Abin da take yi da yadda take amfani da AI Katin bai faɗi abin da manhajar take yi ko yadda take amfani da AI ba. Katin ya ambaci nau'in fintech da hanya ɗaya da manhajar ke amfani da AI. Ya kuma faɗi abin da za a yi idan AI na manhajar ya yanke shawarar da ba daidai ba. An duba inshora Ya ce kuɗin suna da inshora ba tare da dubawa ba, ko ya yi hasashe. Ya ambaci bankin abokin hulɗa da ko yana da inshorar FDIC, an duba a BankFind. Ya lura da waɗanne sassan kuɗin ke da inshora ko ba su da shi, da inda aka tabbatar da haka. Saitin tsaro Ba a kunna kowane saitin tsaro ba. Tabbatarwa mai matakai biyu da sanarwar biya a kunne, kuma an cire na'urorin da ba a sani ba. Ya kuma jera ƙarin saiti ɗaya da aka kunna, kamar kulle kati ko iyakar kashe kuɗi. Alamun zamba da kai rahoto Alamun gargaɗi ƙasa da uku, ko babu wurin kai rahoto. Alamun gargaɗin zamba uku da inda za a kai rahoton matsala. Ya haɗa da yadda ake sake kiran kamfanin ta lambar da aka amince da ita. An duba manhaja Ba a duba manhajar kafin amfani ba. An yi binciken abubuwa biyar da i ko a'a ga kowane abu. Mai koyo ya bayyana abin da zai yi idan wani abu ya zama a'a. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

check.q: Wanne ne alamar gargaɗin zambar fintech?
options: Bayanin asusu na wata-wata da kuke jira
Lokutan aiki da reshen banki ya liƙa
Rasitin abin da kuka saya
Matsin lamba ku motsa kuɗinku da sauri zuwa asusun "lafiya"
check.why: Gaggauta ku motsa kuɗi zuwa asusun "lafiya" sanannen zambar yin kamar wani ne.

check.q: Kun sami tes daga "bankinku" da link don gyara wata matsala. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku danna link ɗin ku shiga asusu
Kada ku danna; ku kira bankin ta lambar da ke shafin intanet nasa na hukuma ko a katinku
Ku mayar da amsa da lambar asusunku
Ku tura shi ga abokai
check.why: Ku ne kuke tuntuɓar kamfanin da kanku ta lambar da kuka amince da ita, ba wadda ke cikin saƙon ba.
